```{r}
library(tidyverse)
four_stream_avg_plot <- read_csv("output/four_stream_avg_long.csv")
ggplot(
  data = all_together_pivot,
  mapping = aes(
    x = (as.Date(window_start)),
    y = Concentration,
    color = sample_id
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(Nutrient ~ ., scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Date") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Concentration") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(1989 - 09 - 01))
```
